boards.reply: Agar plant murjhaaya dikhe, observation hai. Testable question: “Kya zyada paani se plant zyada healthy rahega?” Aap apna question banaiye.
Aarav, Science mein authority nahi, observation aur measurement decide karte hain: naya evidence purani idea ko badal sakta hai. Aap ek example dijiye.
Do plants mein se ek zyada badhe: observation ko “kis condition se growth badlegi?” mein badalna testable question hai. Aap plants ke liye apna question boliye.
Aarav, agar do plants mein sirf light alag ho aur ek roz observation karein, result evidence banega. Aap kya compare karenge?
Jaise cricket ball ko do baar naapkar speed alag mile, toh authority nahi, repeated measurements par idea badlega. Aap kaunsa evidence note karenge?

Jaise cricket mein same ball ko wet aur dry karke dekhein: “Kya wet ball zyada swing karegi?” Yeh testable question hai, kyunki ise experiment se check kar sakte hain. Aap is example mein kya observe karenge?
Aarav, ek measurement galat ho sakta hai; baar-baar same tareeke se milta result evidence ko reliable banata hai. Aap kitni baar naapenge?
poochkar testable question banta hai. Aap wet ball mein kya compare karenge?
